findings.title: SendGrid `@sendgrid/client` API key is never set in `scheduleEmailReminders`
findings.body: In `packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts`, `sgMail.setApiKey(sendgridAPIKey)` is called on line 19, but `client.setApiKey(sendgridAPIKey)` (for `@sendgrid/client`) is never called (unlike in `emailReminderManager.ts` lines 25-26). As a result, when this cron endpoint runs in a serverless invocation that hasn't imported `emailReminderManager.ts`, all `client.request(...)` calls—including the new `POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends` cancellation call at lines 57-64 and `POST /v3/mail/batch` at lines 188-191—will fail with 401 Unauthorized from SendGrid, preventing scheduled email reminders from being cancelled or scheduled.

findings.title: `immediateDelete` in `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` bypasses the deferred cancellation queue and leaves stale DB rows
findings.body:
When `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` is called with `immediateDelete = true` (which this PR passes when rescheduling a booking in `handleNewBooking.ts:968`, deleting a workflow in `workflows.tsx:214`, or deleting a workflow step in `workflows.tsx:521`), it immediately sends `POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends` to SendGrid and returns without deleting or updating the `workflowReminder` record in the database. This causes two problems:
1. For reminders scheduled up to 72 hours out, immediate cancellation occupies one of SendGrid's 100 pending `scheduled_sends` cancellation slots until `scheduledDate`—the exact limit this PR was designed to avoid by deferring cancellations to within 1 hour of `scheduledDate`.
2. When rescheduling a booking (`handleNewBooking.ts`), the `workflowReminder` row is neither deleted nor marked `cancelled: true`; if the booking is later cancelled or modified, the reminder will be processed a second time.

findings.title: Cancelling a paid booking returns early before cancelling workflow reminders or scheduled jobs
findings.body: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, if `bookingToDelete.paid` is true (line 363), the handler refunds the payment, updates the booking status to `REJECTED`, and returns early at line 464. Because `deleteScheduledEmailReminder`, `deleteScheduledSMSReminder`, and `cancelScheduledJobs` are only invoked at lines 480-493 after that early return, any scheduled email or SMS workflow reminders for a cancelled paid booking are never cancelled and will still be sent to the attendee and host.

findings.title: Unawaited reminder cancellations in `forEach` race with `eventManager.reschedule`
findings.body: In `handleNewBooking.ts` lines 966-972, `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` and `deleteScheduledSMSReminder` are async functions invoked inside a synchronous `forEach` without `await` (so the surrounding `try / catch` also cannot catch any rejections). Immediately after, `await eventManager.reschedule(...)` runs, which deletes the old booking's `workflowReminders` via `prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany`. The unawaited `prisma.workflowReminder.delete` / `update` calls inside `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` and `deleteScheduledSMSReminder` race with `eventManager.reschedule` and will fail with Prisma P2025 (record not found) or may be skipped if the serverless function finishes before the promises settle. The same unawaited `forEach` pattern before deleting the parent record also occurs in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/workflows.tsx` at lines 212-225 and 519-531.
